sheets.title: JESB LOT 7 - EXTERIOR MODEL R13
sheets.subtitle: SketchUp model rebuilt from the architect's floor plan and elevation DWGs (issue 17.10.2026)
index: QA - model roof plan over A-220 (red)
notes: Design: Purohit Architects, Inc. (202601.LOT 7), Revision 1. Modelled as drawn; exterior only, no interior.
Plan geometry from the floor plan DWGs xflr0/1/2 (17.10.2026); heights, roof heights and window heads/sills from the elevation DWG xelev; roof layout from A-220.
Datum: z = 0 at the top of the main floor (839.20'). Front faces west.

Materials per the ACC Material Package, Lot 7: roof Mission Brown, brick Magnolia, siding Cobble Stone, trims / soffit / fascia / windows white, front and garage doors brown (cottage style with glass on top).
Grade from the elevation grade lines only (no site plan). Driveway is an assumption.

R02: lower front gable over the garage bump with eave returns; garage gable eaves per the front elevation. R03: decorative textured panels (white frame, speckled field) at all seven panel positions of the elevations. R04: cast-stone headers over first-floor openings, window casings and surrounds, thin grid muntins (4 lites per unit) on all windows; frieze band at 228.6..238.1. R05: front stair window as two stacked units with a frame transom, each with its grid.
R06: roof at the wing / main roof junction corrected to the A-220 roof plan (front-left main roof 6:12 from y 388, cricket hip to x 232); A-902 roof plan QA.
R07: one continuous stone header and surround over grouped windows (rear ranks, guest bay); iron railings on the entry steps and the terrace stair, as on the elevations.

R08: all finishes applied from the ACC Material Package, Lot 7 (sample images as textures): roof Mission Brown, brick Magnolia, siding Cobble Stone, siding dec / trims / soffit / fascia / windows White, front and garage doors Brown.
R09 (owner decisions 17.10.2026): accent metal roofs dark brown bronze; window headers stay light beige cast stone.
R10: accent metal roofs re-textured as true standing seam (16 in panels, seams down the slope), dark brown bronze.
R11 (owner answers to RFI-001, 17.10.2026): garage front per the elevations (9.36 in forward); terrace slider head 7 ft 0 in; wing gable window and six-panel entry door per the front elevation.
R12 (owner, RFI-001.03 - use the DWG): main roof end hips 6:12 as drawn on the rear elevation, ridge 131 in. The front elevation and A-220 (9:12, ridge 308 in) now differ.
R13 (owner 17.10.2026): covered terrace deck and skirt in white lap siding (ACC Siding Dec - White).

Open items: see JESB_Lot7_Model_R13_Change_Log.md (garage front moved 9.36 in. in the new first floor plan but not on the elevations; portico upper window 60 in. in plan vs 86 in. on the elevation; and others).
